name: What is the typical renovation process for a fixer-upper?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical renovation process for a fixer-upper?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our renovation process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site assessment and provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we move to design planning and permit acquisition. The construction phase involves demolition, structural work, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, installations, and finishes. We maintain open communication throughout, culminating in a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction and project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, assessment, estimate, design, permits, demolition, construction, installations, and a final walkthrough.
